product.name: ArangoDB
product.classification: ArangoDB does not fit neatly into only one NoSQL family. It is multi-model: it stores JSON-like documents, models graph vertices and edges, and supports key-based document access.
product.best_for: Applications such as a commerce platform that needs flexible product documents and connected data such as recommendations or product relationships.
product.limitation: A multi-model system adds operational and data-modeling complexity; a specialist database may be simpler when only one access pattern is needed.
product.reason: Its document collections, graph capabilities, and key-based document retrieval span more than one NoSQL model.
